# Chase on Two Wheels Rides S4 Honcho and Falls in Love


What happens when you take everything people love about mini-motos and add instant torque?


Chase on Two Wheels recently took S4 Honcho Street out for his signature First Ride series, and it didn’t take long for it to make an impression. We’ll let Chase take it from here.


“As far as minibikes go, I love this one more than any other minibike I’ve ever ridden.”


—[Chaseontwowheels](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCidMMQafCAomjuD_a3DcdHw)


**Would you ride it? What’s your take on the review? Drop your thoughts below.**
